meta.title: Long-task relay
meta.description: Turn a long task into a session chain: the truth source lives in workspace files, and when context nears its limit the plugin wraps up, opens a fresh session, and hands the work over. A sidebar panel monitors every chain and session.

ui.confirmDelete: Delete this chain? Its features, progress, handoff brief, and audit log are removed too; this cannot be undone.
ui.deleteBlocked: Pause the chain before deleting it
